terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These Terms of Use govern your use of the Zip Client launcher ("Zip") and the Zip website. Zip is produced by Krizuvo. By downloading, installing or using Zip, or by using the website, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use Zip.

sections.heading: 1. What Zip is
body: Zip is a free desktop launcher for Windows and Linux that installs and starts Minecraft: Java Edition and compatible community projects, and manages instances, mods, resource packs, shaders and skins.

Zip is an independent, unofficial project. It is not an official Minecraft product and is not approved by or associated with Mojang AB or Microsoft Corporation. Zip does not include Minecraft. It downloads game files from Mojang's official servers for your own use.

sections.heading: 2. Licence to use Zip
body: Krizuvo grants you a free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable licence to download, install and use Zip on devices you own or control, for personal purposes.

You may not sell Zip, distribute modified copies as if they were official releases, remove copyright or legal notices, or use the Zip or Krizuvo names or logos in a way that suggests endorsement. If Krizuvo publishes the source code under an open-source licence, that licence governs the source code and takes precedence over this section for the code it covers.

sections.heading: 3. Your Minecraft account and game ownership
body: Playing online and on most servers requires a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition. You remain bound by the Minecraft End User License Agreement, the Minecraft Usage Guidelines and the Microsoft Services Agreement.
Microsoft sign-in happens on Microsoft's own website. Zip never asks for or stores your Microsoft password.
Offline profiles are for singleplayer and offline-mode servers only. You must not use Zip to play Minecraft without owning it or to bypass ownership checks, server bans or other protection measures.

sections.heading: 4. Third-party services and content
body: Zip connects to third-party services when you use features that need them, including Microsoft, Mojang, Modrinth, CurseForge, the Fabric, Quilt, Forge and NeoForge project servers, Eclipse Adoptium and GitHub. Your use of those services is governed by their own terms and privacy policies.

Mods, modpacks, resource packs, shaders, skins and the Horizon project are created by third parties. Krizuvo does not create, review or control them and is not responsible for their content, safety, licensing or behaviour. Install third-party content only from sources you trust and respect its licence.

sections.heading: 5. Acceptable use
body: You agree not to use Zip or the website to break the law, infringe intellectual property rights, distribute malware, attack or overload any service, circumvent security or licensing measures, or interfere with other players.

sections.heading: 6. Updates
body: Zip can check the official Zip releases on GitHub for updates and ask whether you want to install them. Updates are only installed when their digital signature matches Zip's release key. You can skip an update or turn update checks off in Settings.

sections.heading: 7. Availability and changes
body: Zip is provided free of charge. Krizuvo may change, suspend or discontinue Zip or any feature at any time. Third-party services may change or stop working without notice, which can affect features of Zip.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how the Zip Client launcher ("Zip") and the Zip website handle personal data, in line with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). In short: Zip has no telemetry, no analytics, no advertising and no Krizuvo account. Your data stays on your computer.

sections.heading: 1. Who is responsible
body: The controller for the Zip website and for the Zip software is Krizuvo (krizuvo.xyz). You can contact Krizuvo by email at krizuvo@krizuvo.xyz, including for any request about your personal data.

sections.heading: 2. Data Zip keeps on your computer
body: Zip stores its data locally on your computer: in %APPDATA%\Zip on Windows, in ~/.local/share/Zip on Linux, in ~/.var/app/dev.ziplauncher.app for the Flatpak, or next to the portable executable if you choose portable mode. This includes settings, instances and their game folders, playtime and launch history, the last ten launch logs, your skin library, cached metadata and a launcher log.

If you sign in with Microsoft, Zip stores your Minecraft profile name, UUID and skin address, plus your Microsoft refresh token and Minecraft access token. On Windows the tokens are encrypted with Windows Data Protection (DPAPI) so only your Windows account can read them. On Linux they are kept in a file that only your user account can read. They are never written to logs.
None of this data is sent to Krizuvo. You can delete it at any time by removing accounts or instances in Zip, or by deleting the Zip data folder after uninstalling.

sections.heading: 3. No telemetry or tracking
body: Zip does not collect usage statistics, crash reports, device identifiers or analytics, and it contains no advertising or tracking code. Krizuvo operates no server that Zip reports to.

sections.heading: 4. Connections to third parties
body: When you use a feature that needs the internet, Zip connects directly from your computer to the service that provides it. That service receives your IP address and the technical request data, and processes it as an independent controller under its own privacy policy:

Microsoft and Xbox Live (sign-in, token refresh); Mojang and Minecraft services (game files, profile, skins, skin uploads, Minecraft news); Modrinth and CurseForge (searching and downloading content); the Fabric, Quilt, Forge and NeoForge servers (mod loader files); Eclipse Adoptium and GitHub (Java runtimes when needed); GitHub (Zip update checks, Zip news, Horizon downloads and Horizon mods).
Minecraft itself, Horizon and any mods you install may process data under their own policies. Minecraft's own telemetry setting is found in the game's options.

sections.heading: 5. Legal bases
body: Connections to third-party services happen because you request a feature (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR). Automatic update checks are based on Krizuvo's legitimate interest in keeping Zip secure and working (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR); you can turn them off in Settings.

sections.heading: 6. The website
body: The Zip website uses no cookies, no analytics, no tracking pixels and no externally loaded fonts or scripts. The hosting provider may process technical access data (IP address, time, requested page, browser type) in server logs to deliver the site and keep it secure (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR), and deletes it according to its own retention rules.
Download links lead to GitHub. When you follow them, GitHub processes your data under the GitHub Privacy Statement.

sections.heading: 7. Retention
body: Local data stays on your computer until you delete it. Zip keeps only the last ten launch logs per instance and prunes its cache to the limit you set in Settings.

sections.heading: 8. Your rights
body: Under the GDPR you have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection, and the right to withdraw consent at any time. Because Krizuvo does not receive data from Zip, most requests can be fulfilled directly in Zip or by deleting your local data. To exercise your rights with Krizuvo, email krizuvo@krizuvo.xyz. For data held by third-party services, contact those services.
You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, in particular in the EU member state of your residence, place of work or the place of the alleged infringement.

sections.heading: 9. Children
body: Zip is not directed at children under 16. Microsoft accounts for younger players are managed through Microsoft family settings, which Zip respects.

sections.heading: 10. Security
body: Zip uses encrypted HTTPS connections, verifies the checksums of game files, Java runtimes and mods, protects account tokens (Windows DPAPI encryption on Windows, user-only file permissions on Linux) and only installs updates signed with Zip's release key. Horizon builds are verified against Horizon's own signed checksums.

sections.heading: 11. Changes
body: Krizuvo may update this policy. The current version and its effective date are shown on the website and in Zip.

sections.heading: Not an official Minecraft product
body: NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.

Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang Synergies AB. Mojang and Microsoft are trademarks of their respective owners. Zip does not distribute Minecraft. Game files are downloaded from Mojang's official servers for players who use them under the Minecraft EULA.

sections.heading: Horizon
body: The Horizon (Rust) option uses Horizon, an independent open-source project by its own authors (github.com/horizon-rust), published under the MIT licence. Krizuvo is not affiliated with the Horizon project and does not control its software, releases or mods. Horizon is itself unofficial and not associated with Mojang or Microsoft.

sections.heading: Third-party content
body: Mods, modpacks, resource packs, shaders and skins available through Zip are made by third parties and provided by services such as Modrinth, CurseForge and horizon-mods. Krizuvo does not create, endorse or guarantee them. You use them at your own risk and must follow their licences.

body: Microsoft, Windows and Xbox are trademarks of Microsoft Corporation. Modrinth, CurseForge, Fabric, Quilt, Forge, NeoForge, Eclipse Adoptium, Temurin and GitHub are trademarks of their respective owners. These names are used only to describe compatibility. Their use does not imply endorsement.

sections.heading: No warranty
body: Zip is provided free of charge and "as is". To the extent permitted by law, Krizuvo gives no warranty that Zip is error-free, uninterrupted or suitable for a particular purpose. Keep backups of your worlds and files. See the Terms of Use for the limitation of liability.

sections.heading: Website content and links
body: Information on the website is provided for general information and may change without notice. Links to external websites are provided for convenience. Krizuvo has no control over their content and accepts no responsibility for them. Screenshots show the Zip launcher and may contain Minecraft imagery, used in accordance with the Minecraft Usage Guidelines.

body: Zip is built with open-source software, including Tauri (MIT/Apache-2.0), Vue (MIT), Pinia (MIT), skinview3d (MIT), three.js (MIT), the Inter and Caveat typefaces (SIL Open Font License 1.1) and many Rust crates under their respective licences. All rights in these components remain with their authors.
